title: React
label: React
desc: A JavaScript library for building user interfaces from composable components.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Scaffold a client-side app with Vite and mount the root component.

snippets.code:
# Create a React app with the Vite template
npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev

import { StrictMode } from 'react'
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import App from './App.jsx'
import './index.css'

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <App />
  </StrictMode>,
)

sections.title: Components
sections.description: A component is a function that returns JSX; small pieces compose into screens.

sections.title: Props
sections.description: Props flow down from parent to child; destructure them and set defaults.

sections.title: State
sections.description: useState stores a value between renders; the setter schedules a re-render.

sections.title: Effects
sections.description: useEffect runs side effects after rendering; return a cleanup to undo them.

sections.title: Events
sections.description: Pass a function to event props and read the event object for values.

sections.title: Lists and Keys
sections.description: Turn arrays into elements with map and give each item a stable key.

sections.title: Forms
sections.description: Controlled inputs keep the DOM in sync with state; validate before submitting.

sections.title: Context
sections.description: Context shares a value with deep children without passing props at every level.

sections.title: Refs
sections.description: useRef holds a mutable value across renders and can point at a DOM node.

sections.title: Custom Hooks
sections.description: Move reusable stateful logic into a function whose name starts with use.

sections.title: Memoization
sections.description: Skip repeated work with memo for components and useMemo or useCallback for values.

sections.title: Routing
sections.description: React Router maps paths to elements; nested routes render through Outlet.

sections.title: Data Fetching
sections.description: Handle loading and error states in an effect, or unwrap a cached promise with use.

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: Render components with Testing Library and interact the way a user would.

snippets.code:
import '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest'
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import { expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
import UserName from './UserName'

test('shows the name after the request resolves', async () => {
  vi.stubGlobal(
    'fetch',
    vi.fn(() =>
      Promise.resolve({ ok: true, json: () => Promise.resolve({ name: 'Ada' }) }),
    ),
  )

  render(<UserName id={1} />)

  expect(await screen.findByText('Ada')).toBeInTheDocument()
  vi.unstubAllGlobals()
})
